_help: Written by the orchestrator from the user's prompt (PROTOCOL.md step 1), then checked by study.py init. Units N, mm. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
prompt:
Use the optimization orchestrator agent (including Abaqus verification) to design a composite boom with minimum mass and the following constraints:
1 m long, any cross-section/material/layup from the respective catalogs, does not buckle under a 50 N lateral bending load in a cantilever beam configuration, transverse bending stiffness such that it has no more than 1 mm deflection under 25 N tip load as a cantilever beam, torsional stiffness such that it will not rotate more than 1 degree under 100 N*mm end torque, coils on 100 mm hub, ensure no material failure throughout the simulation runs.
Do not use more than 16 CPU cores, and do not modify anything outside the BenazzoVenkatadri_ThinShellSims folder.  Provide a status update every 15 minutes.  Put all code you create during this optimization in Code for Project / 11/17/26 (Tara).

bending_stiffness.text: transverse bending stiffness such that it has no more than 1 mm deflection under 25 N tip load as a cantilever beam (k >= 25 N / 1 mm = 25 N/mm, tip load along z)

buckling.text: does not buckle under a 50 N lateral bending load in a cantilever beam configuration (50 N x 1000 mm = 50,000 N mm root moment, lateral = bending in y, about the z axis; checked as a uniform end moment, which puts the root moment along the whole boom: conservative)

torsional_stiffness.text: torsional stiffness such that it will not rotate more than 1 degree under 100 N*mm end torque (GJ >= T L / theta)

failure_load_cases.name: lateral50N
failure_load_cases.text: ensure no material failure throughout the simulation runs: Hashin F < 1 under the 50 N lateral (y) tip load, linear, cantilever

coiling.text: coils on 100 mm hub (radius, user answer 2026-11-17)

_clarifications: User answers 2026-11-17 (chat): lateral bending load = y direction (buckling about z axis); transverse stiffness = tip load along z (sign -1, opposite sense as in earlier studies); hub 100 mm is the RADIUS; torsion added to study.py as a new constraint (step loadcases; user-approved); Abaqus scratch under F:/Tara/abaqus_scratch allowed (temporary, removed by run_abaqus.py). 'No material failure throughout': Hashin F < 1 in the static 25 N case (objective-constraints), the 100 N mm torque case and the 50 N lateral tip-load case (linear); the nonlinear buckling path is not failure-checked (the skill does not save its fields). CPU cap: user 16; PROTOCOL 6a caps Abaqus at 8 per job; OpenSees buckling scan workers 16 (study.py BUCKLING_SOLVER).
